_why: Lowest allowed share of rows with a value per field of filter/universum.json, in percent. Measured on the feed of 30.10.2026 minus 5 points (ath, which only 5.5 % of the rows carry: minus a fifth). d52 stood at 75.1 % that day because of the bug this guard was built for: its floor is the share expected after the full-pull price fix, 99.7 %, minus 5. aus lists exclusions, so an empty one is no gap. Checked by scripts/feed-fill-guard.js.
_why_rotstellen: Red spots (Rotstellen, Regelblatt Teil 2): an intended loss found after the fact, with owner and an expiry at most 14 days out. Daylauf 16, 12.11.2026: Tag 1538 (stale price gate, merged 07.11., first live on 10.11.) withholds the market cap and the ratios built on the same old Yahoo quote; its own replay of 24.10. predicted 1,185 withheld market caps and did not lower these floors. Measured feed of 11.11. against 07.11.: 1,167 rows lost mc, 1,132 of them carry the stale-quote reason in aus (911 Milan second listings), 12 the class-sum reason (Tag 1545), 23 others are newly data-suspect (off the board, market cap fails the currency check), offset by 26 gains. Temporary floor = share of 11.11. minus 2 points (drift 10.11. to 11.11. at most 0.14 points); seit and bis both count, 14 days. Before bis the owner either lowers the floor for good in a reviewed pull request (as the guard's contract asks of a deliberate loss) or the guard learns to count withheld-with-reason values; then this block goes.
